verdict.rationale: Firstbase's compliance dashboard tracks per-state deadlines and requirements, and its registered agent/tax software services claim to handle filings, extensions, and multi-state expansion (firstbase-docs-7, firstbase-docs-14, firstbase-docs-10). However, community evidence shows the burden of actual annual report filing still fell on the user in practice (had to hire a Fiverr freelancer for a required filing) and Wyoming annual report fees were separate out-of-pocket costs, suggesting the platform's 'we handle it all' claims aren't fully automated. Missing for 10: independent confirmation that Firstbase itself files annual reports/franchise tax without user intervention, and clearer evidence separating registered-agent notification from actual tax/report filing execution.
